meta.title: Orthodontics | The British Dental Hub
meta.description: Straighten your smile with metal braces, ceramic braces, or clear aligners, planned with digital precision for adults, teenagers, and children in Cairo.

hero.subtitle: Orthodontic treatment is planned calmly and precisely, with a personalised treatment timeline built around your goals — for adults, teenagers, and children alike.

types.title: Types of Orthodontic Treatment
types.subtitle: The right system is selected around your clinical needs, daily lifestyle, and how discreet you'd like treatment to be.

metal.title: Metal Braces
metal.description: A traditional, highly effective system of metal brackets and wires that reliably corrects a wide range of orthodontic cases.
metal.note: Ideal for: comprehensive correction and dependable, well-proven results

ceramic.title: Ceramic Braces
ceramic.description: Tooth-coloured ceramic brackets that work the same way as traditional braces while blending naturally with your smile.
ceramic.note: Ideal for: effective correction with a more discreet appearance

aligners.title: Clear Aligners
aligners.description: A series of clear, removable trays that gradually and comfortably guide teeth into their ideal position.
aligners.note: Ideal for: a virtually invisible, flexible everyday option

digitalPlanning.title: Digital Treatment Planning
digitalPlanning.subtitle: A digital workflow helps map your treatment precisely before it begins, reducing uncertainty and guiding a considered result.
digitalPlanning.cardTitle: A plan mapped before treatment starts
digitalPlanning.cardDescription: An intraoral scan replaces messy impression trays, diagnostic X-rays give a clear picture of teeth and jaw structure, and specialised software brings it all together into a personalised treatment plan.

scanning.title: Intraoral Digital Scanning
scanning.description: A digital scanner captures precise, detailed impressions of your teeth without messy trays.

xrays.title: Diagnostic X-Rays
xrays.description: X-rays help assess tooth position, roots, and jaw structure to guide safe, accurate planning.

planning.title: Digital Treatment Planning
planning.description: Your case is mapped in specialised planning software to shape a considered, personalised approach.

whoIsItFor.title: Who Is Orthodontic Treatment For
whoIsItFor.subtitle: Orthodontic care is planned around your stage of life, not a single one-size-fits-all approach.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: It's never too late to improve alignment and confidence — many adults choose treatment for comfort as much as appearance.

teenagers.title: Teenagers
teenagers.description: The most common stage for orthodontic treatment, planned around growth and everyday school life.

children.title: Children
children.description: Early evaluation helps guide healthy jaw and bite development from a young age.

testimonials.title: What Patients Remember
testimonials.subtitle: Beyond the final result, we believe patients should remember the clarity, calm, and consideration of the experience itself.

item1.quote: The whole process felt calm and clearly explained from the very first visit. I always knew exactly what to expect at each stage.

item2.quote: Every option was explained patiently, and I felt fully involved in choosing the right treatment for me.

item3.quote: The team made the entire experience comfortable, from the first scan to the final review.

item4.quote: I appreciated how carefully everything was planned before we even started.

consultationCta.title: Ready to Straighten Your Smile?
consultationCta.description: Every successful orthodontic treatment begins with a comprehensive consultation. We'll assess your smile, explain every available option, and shape a personalised treatment timeline around your clinical needs.
consultationCta.noPressure: No pressure. Just honest clinical advice.
consultationCta.contactNote: Our team will personally contact you to arrange your consultation at a convenient time.
